versions.changelog:
feishu-upload-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release with complete file upload and send-to-chat capabilities for Feishu (Lark)
- Supports local file upload (up to 30MB), multiple file types, and automatic token management
- Includes error handling, logging (with debug mode), and permission checks
- Provides Bash and Node.js scripts for flexible integration
- Requires Node.js 18+; no external dependencies needed
- MIT licensed
